Description: A bird embryo within a pre-born egg.
A bird that remains in the nest until it is able to fly.
A bird that has left the nest and is acquiring its first set of flight feathers, but is still dependent upon parent birds for food and care.
A young bird, not yet capable of breeding, in its first plumage of non-downy feathers. This plumage is mostly soft feathers that quickly abrade and are replaced by a later molt.
A mature bird capable of breeding and in its definitive plumage.
A deceased bird, adult or not.
A recently born mammal, dependant on milk for nourishment.
A mammal that has weaned off its mother but has not yet reached its adult form (sexual or physical maturity).
A mature mammal capable of breeding.
A deceased mammal, adult or not.

A deceased invertebrate at any lifestage.
